onboarding.welcomeText: Shalav helps you study university courses: a study plan, explanations and practice, with Claude as your private tutor.

moodle.title: Import from Moodle
moodle.hint: The first time, Shalav downloads its own browser (about 190 MB). A login window opens so you can log in to your university Moodle (including two-step verification), then it closes and the import runs in the background. Shalav never sees your password.

custom.title: Create a custom course
custom.intro: Learn anything you like: tell us what and where you start from, and the study plan is built around you.
custom.name: Course name
custom.descriptionPh: What do you want to learn? Which topics, why, and anything you already know or want to skip.
custom.descriptionHint: Elaborate as much as you can: the more detail, the better the study plan fits you.

web.title: Materials from the internet
web.body: Claude searches the web for study texts and practice exercises that match your level ({{level}}/5) and adds them to your course files. Then press {{plan}} to fit the plan to them.
web.countNew: Only files not already in your course are added.
web.countPlan: Only files not already in your course are added, spread over the plan's units so each one gets a fair share.

loop.drop: Stuck? Upload what you've written so far and press Get a clue. Done? Upload the whole solution (photo or PDF) and submit it.

intro.homework: Upload the homework pages. Shalav reads the questions, then you choose how to solve them.
intro.single: Upload the question. You'll solve it with the tutor: ask for a clue when you're stuck, and submit your full solution when you're done.
